global_rules.forecast_encoding: dashed line or lighter tint plus explicit forecast label
global_rules.missing_data: show gap or explicit n/a; never silently interpolate

rules.question: How did a metric change over time?
rules.encoding: time on x; value on y; focal series red; historical comparators neutral
rules.labels: latest value, start/end values, material inflection points
integrity: avoid truncated bar-chart axes without explicit analytical reason

rules.question: Which categories contribute most?
rules.encoding: descending order; one focal category red
rules.labels: direct value labels; unit in axis/title
integrity: show total or denominator when share is used

rules.question: What is the composition of a total?
rules.labels: segment value/share if legible; total label
integrity: parts reconcile to total or disclose rounding/residual
do not use 100% stack when absolute scale matters

rules.question: How do groups differ across multiple metrics?
rules.encoding: shared scale for comparable metrics; otherwise label scale per panel

rules.question: How do we rank entities?
rules.encoding: sort by metric; focal entity red; others grey
integrity: population, period, ranking definition and source present

rules.question: Where are operations or customers located?
rules.encoding: sequential intensity for one measure; separate callout for second measure
rules.labels: region name and value for priority regions
integrity: legend bins and geographic scope visible

rules.question: What explains the change from A to B?
rules.encoding: positive/negative/total roles distinct; start/end neutral, key driver red

rules.question: Where are customer segments positioned by value and need?
rules.data_shape: two quantitative axes plus optional third variable
rules.encoding: axes named; bubble size encodes only one additional variable
rules.labels: segment names; quadrants have actionable meaning
integrity: bubble area, not radius, encodes magnitude

rules.question: What is the conversion through a journey?
rules.encoding: stage order; count and stage-to-stage conversion
rules.labels: n and conversion percentage with denominator
integrity: stage populations nested or non-nested flow explained

rules.question: How do channels work together?
rules.encoding: lanes represent actors or channels; arrows represent handoffs
integrity: every handoff has source and destination

qa_checks: axes and baselines are not misleading
